data.scenario_title: Cross-national news consumption habits and media trust survey across five OECD nations, 2021–2024
data.data_context: An international media observatory and comparative research network conducted periodic population-weighted survey waves between January 2021 and December 2024 across five countries. The research tracks shifting reliance on digital channels versus traditional broadcasting, audience trust in primary information sources, and weekly engagement intensity.

intents.sentence: Average media trust score compared across primary news sources
Trend of weekly news consumption hours across survey waves over time
Relationship between daily news access frequency and reported trust score

data.script:
dim("country", ["United States", "United Kingdom", "Germany", "France", "Japan"],
    weights=[0.25, 0.22, 0.20, 0.18, 0.15], group="geography")
dim("age_group", ["18-24", "25-34", "35-54", "55+"],
    weights=[0.20, 0.28, 0.30, 0.22], ordered="ordinal", group="demographics")
dim("main_news_source", ["Social Media", "Online News Sites", "Television", "Printed Press", "Radio"],
    parent="age_group",
    weights={"18-24": [0.46, 0.34, 0.10, 0.02, 0.08],
             "25-34": [0.36, 0.38, 0.15, 0.03, 0.08],
             "35-54": [0.18, 0.36, 0.28, 0.06, 0.12],
             "55+":   [0.06, 0.22, 0.46, 0.12, 0.14]},
    group="demographics")

time("survey_date", start="2021-01-01", end="2024-12-31", freq="monthly")

measure("weekly_news_hours",
        "gamma(shape = 3.5 + 1.2*[age_group=55+] - 0.8*[main_news_source=Social Media], scale = 1.6)",
        unit="hours", additive=True)
measure("trust_score",
        "clip(6.5 + 1.2*[main_news_source=Printed Press] + 0.8*[main_news_source=Television] + 0.6*[main_news_source=Radio] - 1.8*[main_news_source=Social Media] + 0.5*[country=Germany] - 0.6*[country=United States] + gaussian(0, 1.2), 0, 10)",
        unit="points", additive=False)
measure("news_frequency_per_day",
        "poisson(lam = 2.4 + 1.4*[main_news_source=Social Media] + 0.8*[main_news_source=Online News Sites] + 0.3*[age_group=25-34])",
        unit="check-ins", additive=True)

emit(380)
